status: Phase 2 predeclared after RF-only candidates failed unchanged integration gates
reason: The 36 numeric measurements collapse many differently labelled training URLs to the same vectors. Character patterns add information instead of relaxing the recall/FPR gate or raising threshold.
representation: Same a3-scheme-neutral-v1 model view; original raw input is still used for explanations. Character n-grams of length 3–5 plus 36 numeric features. No domain whitelist, demo injection, test scoring or threshold tuning.
numeric: StandardScaler(with_mean=False) fitted to train only; numeric columns remain in A2 order after A3 canonical representation.
gate: Unchanged criteria and ranking in PLAN.json; 90% dangerous recall, 80% phishing recall, <=20% FPR and >=50% relative reduction versus API-formatted A2, >=75% valid-format flip reduction, zero domain overlap. Demo outputs inspected only after selection.
limits: Additional exploratory development reuses validation; no unbiased final-test or live safety estimate is claimed. Existing source/collection bias may remain.
